workstreams.title: Build queue and progress
workstreams.purpose: Keep the agent queue full without the Executor promoting each ticket.

workstreams.title: Home page and build history
workstreams.purpose: Replace the dashboard home with the continuous build-history view (MP-E8).

workstreams.title: Prior refactor units
workstreams.purpose: Land the older U0-U7/U9 units; U0 is the review gate for all refactor work.

workstreams.title: Size reduction
workstreams.purpose: Split the oversized files named by the U8 size ledger.

workstreams.title: Component map and kernel
workstreams.purpose: Component manifest, identity, capabilities, config, journal, routes and docs.

workstreams.title: Tracker ports and GitHub listeners
workstreams.purpose: Split the tracker contract and move GitHub polling into listeners.

workstreams.title: Event bus and export
workstreams.purpose: One event contract with durable consumers, a topic catalog and an export API.

workstreams.title: Harness adapters
workstreams.purpose: Per-harness delivery primitives, native steer and the adapter package.

workstreams.title: Command delivery and answering
workstreams.purpose: Commands reach the right responder and can be answered on every surface.

workstreams.title: Executor session and view
workstreams.purpose: Attach the Executor's own session and show its state in the dashboard.

workstreams.title: Conversation journal and view
workstreams.purpose: Durable conversation journal, anchors and the conversation view.

workstreams.title: Listener modes and send path
workstreams.purpose: Steer, sync and async listener modes and one send path for every client.

workstreams.title: Voice input and dictation
workstreams.purpose: The voice port and dictation on dashboard, phone and watch.

workstreams.title: Conversational voice assistant
workstreams.purpose: Converse with a voice assistant that drafts instructions for agents.

workstreams.title: Device pairing and gateway
workstreams.purpose: Machine store, gateway, pairing, device tokens and device management.

workstreams.title: Encrypted push and notifications
workstreams.purpose: End-to-end encrypted push through a relay and the notification policy.

workstreams.title: Phone app shell and meta-dashboard
workstreams.purpose: The Expo app, native cores, WebView host and multi-machine summary.

workstreams.title: Watch apps
workstreams.purpose: watchOS and Wear OS apps, watch push and Command cards.

workstreams.title: Operator CLI and accounts
workstreams.purpose: Small operator CLI fixes outside the program waves.

workstreams.title: Feature acceptance QA
workstreams.purpose: One end-to-end QA member per feature, owned by the Executor.
